about: The 65 -> 106 rig swap (Dom + Strategy 2026-10-26; docs/PLAN.md section 10). Every bone or weapon-node lookup in the fight goes through src/fight/rig-bones.ts, which only reads this file (Dom: everything on the data layer). `query`: the URL keys that pick each side's rig (?rig=65|106 the hero, ?foerig=65|106 the opponent). `held`: the 65 rig's weapon-node names (the weapon always in hand or a grafted part, the drawn sword, the sheathed sword), the keys of `weapons`. `detect`: the joint that marks each rig. `bones`: a 65-joint name (V1's warrior/veteran skeleton, the name every lookup and data row uses) -> the 106-joint Mixamo name as the GLB spells it (three.js strips the ':' when it loads: mixamorig:Hips is the object mixamorigHips). `bones` is OpenTrident's map (src/assets/minotaur-106.bones.json `map`, test/rig-bones.test.mjs keeps them equal). `weapons`: a weapon-node name -> the names tried on a 106 body, first found wins: OpenTrident's fk_socket_hand_r first (it carries the 65 rig's WeaponDrawn/SwordDrawn frame; the file's old SwordDrawn node is ~12.7 degrees off), then the body's own node. `hide`: draws on a 106 body that are not shown (OpenTrident's armour layers: Dom 2026-10-26, no armour until after alpha/beta). `gapFill`: on a 106 body only, a role whose clip the body lacks plays the first of these clips it has (the dev bodies ch22/ch25 carry 12 clips; the real files carry the 65 rig's set and fill nothing). `grip65`: where a 65-rig equip part's frame sits in hand_r (warrior.glb's SwordDrawn: translation, rotation xyzw), so a part grafted on a 106 body lands where that body's own SwordDrawn (or fk_socket_hand_r) is. `files`: the 106 file stem under src/assets for a 65 body stem. `default`: which rig each side draws with no query (?rig= the hero, ?foerig= the opponent; '65' = today). Flip a default to '106' once OpenTrident's files are in and Gate 2 has passed.
